column5: FDA approval of 13 November 2026 for Imfinzi with enfortumab vedotin in muscle-invasive bladder cancer in patients ineligible for or refusing cisplatin, 'based on results from the VOLGA Phase III trial' (NCT04960709). It widens a marketed product's label. It is not KUNLUN (NCT04550260, oesophageal cancer) or NIAGARA-2 (NCT06960577, a Phase 2), the two Imfinzi studies it was shown against

Topline of 22 September 2026 from the VK2735-102 maintenance dosing study, 'a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial in approximately 180 adults', which the registry holds as a Phase 1 (NCT07838740). It is not VANQUISH 1 (NCT07104500), the Phase 3 of 4,500 patients the gate rests on, and the release gives no Phase 3 readout
VERITAC-2 met its primary endpoint in ESR1-mutant patients and missed it in all patients (two-sided p = 0.07); no gate on vepdegestrant is priced, so neither half moves a value

52-week follow-up of AMETHYST Part A, the Phase 2 part, which met its primary endpoint in March 2026; the Phase 3 part is still blinded and Biogen expects it in the first half of 2027, so this closes nothing on the calendar

KEYSTEP-008, a randomised Phase 2 with no formal test; the combinations gave modestly higher response rates than pembrolizumab alone and the authors say this does not support further development. The gates on Keytruda rest on other Phase 3 studies
SunRISe-1, single-arm cohorts with no pass or fail test; TAR-200 alone gave an 82.4% complete response rate in cohort 2. The gate priced on Inlexzo rests on another Phase 3 study
COMMUTE-a, single-arm, and Roche's analysis plan sets no formal hypothesis; 59.5% of treatment-naive adults reached complete TMA response by week 25. No gate on Piasky is priced
COMMUTE-p, single-arm, and its analysis plan sets no formal hypothesis; 70.6% of treatment-naive children reached complete TMA response by week 25. No gate on Piasky is priced
TROPiCS-03, a Phase 2 basket study reporting response rates by cohort with no pass or fail test. The gate priced on Trodelvy rests on another Phase 3 study
LYNK-002, a Phase 2 basket study with no hypothesis test; response rates by independent review ran from 8.6% to 28.6% by cohort and were posted only on the registry. No gate on Lynparza is priced
VIVID-2, an open-label long-term extension of an approved use; most patients kept clinical remission and endoscopic response at two years. The gate priced on Omvoh rests on another Phase 3 study
ELARA, a single-arm Phase 3b safety study of monthly aflibercept 8 mg with no pass or fail test; safety was in line with the known profile. No gate on Eylea is priced
